label: Tier 1: configuration
subgoals: Recognize a request that only changes a value the engine reads
Validate that the configured library is still complete

label: Tier 2: plug-ins at existing seams
subgoals: Identify the existing interface the request can implement
Write the plug-in without touching the core
Reject seam abuse such as costs used as prohibitions

label: Tier 3: core edits and seam design
section: Tier 3: core edits and seam design
subgoals: Classify edits to enumeration, matching, covering or legality as core
Steer agents to the smallest tier that can serve the request
Add a seam when one kind of core edit keeps recurring
